assets: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: photorealistic background for an interactive adult nursing IV training game. A single naturalistic clinical photograph, not a diagram, not a UI, no lettering. Overhead close-up of a fictional adult's inner forearm resting horizontally on a clean muted teal sterile drape on a hospital treatment bed. Elbow exits the LEFT edge, relaxed hand enters the RIGHT edge. The entire forearm including wrist lies across the middle third of the image, naturally proportioned realistic warm medium skin with pores and subtle superficial veins, five normal fingers. Palm turned up and gently relaxed. The intended training insertion point is at approximately image x=48%, y=52%, so keep that region bare intact skin. No needles, no cannula, no dressing, no tubing yet, no visible personnel hands, no blood or bruising. Quiet clinical light, premium medical educational photography, lens-correct detail, unobtrusive clinical surroundings. Wide horizontal composition, generous teal drape negative space top and bottom. This is a synthetic educational person, not a real patient. Photorealistic texture, do not draw blue vein lines. No labels, arrows, watermark, or artificial plastic mannequin look.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: photorealistic close clinical nursing training background. A single realistic clinical photograph of a fictional adult medical simulation patient seen from above at a gentle angle, upper torso and base of neck lying on a hospital bed, face cropped OUT above chin. Medical gown and teal drapes cover chest below mid sternum, only upper chest and base of neck are exposed as medically necessary, neutral nonsexual clinical setting. Natural tan adult skin pores, collarbones anatomically correct. A PRE-EXISTING professionally secured triple-lumen central venous catheter enters the patient's right lower neck (viewer LEFT around x=40%, y=35%), under a clean sterile transparent dressing with short flexible three lumens ending in blue, brown and white connectors resting toward lower chest. No puncture or blood, no staff hands, no text or lettering. Clear equipment details and realistic transparent polymer, premium educational medical photography, wide horizontal composition, soft hospital lighting. Not an illustration, not a vector, not a mannequin toy, no exaggerated anatomy. No logos or watermark.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: ONE four-frame photographic atlas for a nursing simulator, arranged in an EXACT 2-column by 2-row grid with equal rectangular cells and no gaps, no separators, no labels. Each frame must stay entirely inside its quadrant with generous teal clinical drape margins and its subject centered near x=50%, y=50% WITHIN THAT CELL. TOP LEFT: realistic adult upper arm with inner upper-arm skin exposed on teal hospital drape, arm lying horizontally from shoulder on left to elbow on right, skin intact, no instruments. TOP RIGHT: adult lower leg and dorsum of foot on teal hospital drape, shin vertical with toes at bottom, anatomically realistic, skin intact, no instruments. BOTTOM LEFT: fictional adult male patient half-upright in a hospital bed, face and upper torso framed, head centered, nasal region clearly visible around local x=50%, y=40%, wearing modest pale hospital gown, neutral cooperative expression, no tube or cannula present. BOTTOM RIGHT: close-up of a clean short closed postoperative superficial incision with intact sutures on an adult forearm resting horizontally on teal sterile drape; skin is clean with mild expected edge pinkness, no pus or active blood, no dressing or hands, incision horizontally at local x=50%, y=50%. Consistent premium real-life clinical photography, detailed normal skin, accurate anatomy, adult fictional patients, calm soft hospital lighting, no toy appearance, no vector or cartoon appearance. Absolutely no UI, text, labels, arrows, watermarks, branding, gutters, or objects crossing between quadrants.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: ONE photographic sprite atlas of medical training equipment, EXACT 7 columns by 4 rows, 28 equal square cells, edge-to-edge grid with NO gaps, NO borders and NO labels. Wide overall aspect 7:4. Every object completely contained in its own cell, centered with 15 percent empty margin, on the SAME matte cool off-white studio surface. Realistic unbranded medical product photography, clear transparent plastics, stainless steel and paper textures; do NOT draw vectors. Critical positions in reading order. ROW 1 cells 1-7: peripheral IV catheter ORANGE hub (14G); peripheral IV catheter GREY hub (16G); peripheral IV catheter GREEN hub (18G); peripheral IV catheter PINK hub (20G); peripheral IV catheter BLUE hub (22G); peripheral IV catheter YELLOW hub (24G); yellow sharps container with red secure lid. All six cannulas are visually the same product family, thin clear flexible cannula with introducer needle, winged colored hub, no syringes mistaken for cannula. ROW 2 cells 1-7: hand disinfectant pump bottle; stainless kidney preparation tray with wrapped material; pair of blue nitrile gloves next to folded sterile drape; blue tourniquet with buckle; amber antiseptic bottle with foam applicator; sterile saline container beside a capped clear syringe; transparent sterile adhesive dressing in peel-open paper wrapper. ROW 3 cells 1-7: white patient identification wristband; small realistic adjustable hospital bed in Fowler position; flexible measuring tape with marker; lubricant tube; coiled nasogastric feeding tube; pH test-strip card with strips; clipboard and pen. ROW 4 cells 1-7: folded used dressing in blue gloved hand lifted from a plain surface, no blood; medical magnifying glass beside neutral skin model for inspection; folded sterile gauze in opened wrapper; triple-lumen central venous catheter set; portable ultrasound console with covered probe; chest X-ray film on a small lightbox; clear needleless IV connector with small alcohol swab. These are educational product images, not instructions. No legible text, digits, brand names, arrows, clinical claims or watermark anywhere. Each object must be recognizable and separate. Preserve exact 28-cell layout; no extra rows or columns.
